help: Blast your foes with lethal radiation. Radiation Blast powers can lower your targets' overall Defense. Radiation Blast attacks have a chance to inflict the Contaminated state on a target for a moderate amount of time. Powers that deal greater damage, have a longer recharge time and animation time have a greater chance to inflict Contaminated. Hitting Contaminated targets with Neutrino Bolt, X-Ray Beam, Proton Volley and Cosmic Burst cause a portion of that power's damage to also hit nearby foes.
